readbacks.message:
feat(mathscope): add source-pinned native cutoff and M4 evidence recovery

Implement original scalar slow inverse and closed-cell outer-cutoff jets with independent reviews. Preserve the inherited M3 62/64 scope, N7-06 and N8-05 OPEN, and null actual global last-resolved tau.

Add scoped M4 provenance and dependency contracts, original 64/16 acceptance matrices, execution receipts, safe intake audit, and bounded CI. Regenerate the preserved-source release manifest without changing existing artifacts.
